second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 10 + Average 9 + Difficulty 4 = 23), pdf 21; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-23 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-8, II 9-12, III 13-16, IV 17-21, V 22-23); answer side keys 1-22 in order (q22 under 'IV 22.'), q23 restated not keyed. BLUE PRINT 10/9/4 = 23 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 23.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 21 (heading, LO 9, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 22 (q3 options-q10) 23 (q11-21) 24 (q22-23). A side 'Key Answers: 4 . The Story of a drop of Water' pdf 102 (keys 1-21), pdf 103 (q22 bullets, restated q23). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode on both sides here; key bullets for q22 print a Kannada copy after the English — dropped).

Sections: s1 I mcq q1-8; s2 II match q9-12 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III fill q13-16; s4 IV q17-21 (header '5 X 1=5' printed on the Kannada heading line); s5 V q22-23. Types by key form: vsa q17, q18, q20, q21 (one sentence/list); sa q19 (two printed sentences: the 'child answer depends' line + one example line + one example line, one step); la q22 (four bullets, five sentences); q23 draw -> sa.
MARKS (R-E9): s1 '8X1=8' -> 1; s2 '4 X 1=4' -> 1; s3 '4 x1=4' -> 1; s4 '5 X 1=5' (5 q) -> 1; s5 '2 X 3= 6' (2 q) -> null, M=3 is not the smaller factor (R-E9 as written).
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 23 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 9, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

KEYS: MCQ letter+text, all agree. q5 option line prints a stray 'B)' before 'C) To take a bath' (layout; options A-D intact). Match keys: 9 Pot->Soil, 10 Syntax->Plastic, 12 STrough->Brick, sand, cement; key 11 prints 'Bucket' (the row's own item; 'Steel' unkeyed) -> flagged, stored as printed; a stray backtick precedes '11)' (kept in answer_as_printed). q17/q20/q21 keys carry printed marking notes '(etc.)', '(Score based on the child's answer)', '(Score based on answer)' — kept verbatim; q21's note wraps ('based' / 'on answer)') joined. q22 bullets: one step per bullet (bullets 3 and 4 wrap once). q23 draw: key restates the instruction -> empty + 'no answer printed'.
Source wording kept verbatim: 'Syntax' (a water-tank brand rendered as a word, q7 option D and q10), 'Give' (q7 A), 'STrough' (q12), 'utencils' (q23), q13 'sources'.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-04-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
